method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation of the Land Tax Assessment Act 2002 (No. 52 of 2002), mrdoc 49123 retrieved 2026-09-07, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49123.txt; no compilation number or date stated; includes the Land Tax Assessment Amendment (Build-to-Rent) Act 2026 (No. 6 of 2026). Rates: Land Tax Act 2002 (No. 51 of 2002) s 5 Table 11 (2015/16 and subsequent years), mrdoc 28122 retrieved 2026-09-07, deposited at ../../../land-tax-act-2002/registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_28122.txt, compilation table ending with the Land Tax Amendment Act 2015 (No. 24 of 2015). The capped-value prescribed percentage (Glossary cl 6(4)) is set by regulations not deposited: an input.

checks.command: l4 run lta-cases-landtax.l4; l4 run lta-qa-cases.l4; l4 check lta-qa.l4
checks.result: lta-cases-landtax.l4: 70 of 70 assertions satisfied; lta-qa-cases.l4: 188 of 188 satisfied; 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file; l4 check lta-qa.l4 succeeds
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the home owner (and the owner of other land), for the WA lives (Chloe c055; Daniel d055, d084): ss 5, 6(1) (due on the 49th day); ss 7(1), 7(4), 8(3) (owner at midnight on 30 June before the assessment year; joint and several; vendor until the buyer has possession); s 9A ($5,000); ss 10, 11(1), 12(1), 12(3) (rate on aggregated taxable value; joint land separate); ss 17, 18 (whole and partial exemption); s 20(3)-(5) (60 days to appeal; tax still payable); s 20A(4); s 21 (private residence exemption: individual, spouses, 2-year de facto partners, guarantor co-owners; trusts and companies excluded; partial exemption for other co-owners an inference); s 23 (one year after death); ss 24, 24A (building a home, 1 and 2 years); s 26A (disabled relative); s 26B (owner in full-time care); s 27 (moving between 2 homes); s 40 ($10,000 for war widows); Glossary cl 1 definitions and cl 6 (taxable value; prescribed percentage an input); Land Tax Act 2002 s 5 Table 11 as a table. Not encoded: subdivision rules, ss 13, 16, 20(1), 22, 23A, 25, 25A, 26, 27A, 28, 28F-28K, Divisions 3-5 except s 40, s 45A, earlier rate tables, the Taxation Administration Act 2003.
seat: the home owner (and the owner of other land)

roles: I own the land, or the home I live in
I hold land for someone else, as their agent, a trustee, or an executor or administrator
I rent or occupy land that someone else owns

situation_parameters.name: I own the land jointly or in common with others
questions: Can I be made to pay all the tax on my joint land
Is my joint land assessed with the land I own alone

situation_parameters.name: I am building, or have built, a new home on the land
questions: Is my land exempt this year under the one year building exemption
Is my land exempt this year under the two year building exemption
Is my land exempt this year while my home is built

situation_parameters.name: I owned two homes at the taxing date, and am moving from one to the other
questions: Is my other home exempt while I move house
Must I tell the Commissioner when I hand over the first home

situation_parameters.name: I was in full-time care at the taxing date
questions: Is my home exempt while I am in full-time care

situation_parameters.name: a disabled person lives on the land as their primary residence
questions: Is my home exempt because my disabled relative lives in it

situation_parameters.name: I have been given a land tax assessment notice
questions: On which day after my notice is my land tax due
Within how many days must I report an error in my notice
What is the most I may be fined for not reporting an error
Up to how much of the land tax am I personally liable for

situation_parameters.name: the Commissioner has refused or revoked an exemption or concession for my land
questions: Within how many days may I appeal to the Minister
Must I still pay while I appeal to the Minister

situation_parameters.name: an event has happened that may affect my land's exemption or concession
questions: By what day must I report an event affecting my exemption

situation_parameters.name: the owner has died, and I am the executor or administrator of their estate
questions: Is the dead owner's home still exempt in my hands

situation_parameters.name: I have paid land tax I was required to pay for the owner or beneficiary
questions: May I recover the land tax I paid for the owner

situation_parameters.name: my lease or agreement says I am to pay the land tax, or pay it back to the owner
questions: Can my lease make me liable to the Commissioner for the land tax
Does the land tax term bind me and the owner

situation_parameters.name: the Commissioner or an investigator has asked me for information about the land
questions: Must I answer the Commissioner about the land
What is the most I may be fined for not answering the Commissioner
